msItem.title: Marḥa ʿǝwwurān
msItem.note: The text is divided into two parts, each starting with a date, though the dates do not match exactly. 1) : 7569 ʿamata śǝggāwe ‘year of the Incarnation’ (most likely the scribe meant the year of Incarnation 1569, i.e., 1576 A.D.), and 1299 ʿamata samāʿtāt ‘year of the martyrs’ (= 1583 A.D). 2) : 7202 ʿamata ʿālam ‘year of the world’ (= 1702 A.D.), 1702 ʿamata śǝggāwe (= 1709 A.D.) and 1427 ʿamata samāʿtāt (= 1711 A.D.). The time span indicated by these dates is about 136 years. Some sections include records of historical events from ca. 1570 to 1702, e.g., on the death of Yǝsḥaq, on killing of ‘ʾAboli Gāllā’, on campaign to Kʷārā, on the coming of Žān Medā, on the death of Queen ʾAdmās Mogasā, on the enthronement of Ḥaḍe Yāʿqob, on the argument between Ḥaḍe Yāʿqob and Rās ʾAtnātewos, on the death of Ḥaḍe Zadǝngǝl, on the victory of Ḥaḍe Susǝnyos over Wǝr(ǝ)nšo (Oromo), on the death of Susǝnyos and the enthronement of Fāsiladas. Some other historical records, in smaller script, by the same and various hand(s) are inserted beside and below the main text on .
